name: Speed O Sound Talon
creator: frog
description:
The blade of the Unseen Blade is now the speed of sound. This custom skin transforms **Talon** into the lightning-fast ninja, **Speed-o'-Sound Sonic**. Get ready to dash through enemies at incredible speed, leaving a trail of sonic booms and chaos. With his signature scarf and a blade that moves faster than the eye can see, this skin is perfect for players who want to dominate the battlefield with unmatched agility and precision.
